name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Buttons attached in one control frame: Button cells on shared seams, each its own Tab stop; text cells and a heavier separator; horizontal or vertical. Toolbar is the one-Tab-stop row; SplitButton the action with its menu.
whenToUse: Use it for a few related buttons that each stay their own Tab stop, such as zoom in and out. For a long row of commands that should be one stop use Toolbar.

parts.name: ButtonGroup
parts.description: Buttons attached in one control frame: cells on shared seams (C1), each button its own Tab stop. Use it for a few related commands that are not a toolbar: Previous · Next, − · 100% · +, Copy · Share. For a row of many commands that should be one Tab stop with arrow keys, use Toolbar; for an action with its menu, SplitButton; for one exclusive choice, Segmented. Children are cells: Button layout="cell", ButtonGroupText, a MenuTrigger rendering a Button cell. `orientation="vertical"` stacks them on horizontal seams. A group inside a group is not drawn (put the groups one gutter apart instead: unrelated parts sit apart).

parts.name: ButtonGroupSeparator
parts.description: A heavier seam between sub-groups of cells (2px, a control's weight) where a plain seam reads as one run. Base UI's Separator, oriented across the group.

parts.name: ButtonGroupText
parts.description: A text cell in the group: a value between steppers, a unit, a label ("Page 3"). Not focusable.
